Package com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.gametest

Class EyeStateOverrideGameTestsLogic

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.gametest.EyeStateOverrideGameTestsLogic
public final class EyeStateOverrideGameTestsLogic extends Object
The EyeState appearance-override mutations behind /sg admin: sparse overrides, atomic tint clearing, snapshot installation, and setGlow(null) dropping the override so eyes fall back to per-eye config glow. Each mutation also sends an EyeStatePacket, which reaches no one here because the test has no tracking players.

The in-game steps below run as a creative operator (permission level 2) looking at a cow that already has eyes (for example, after /sg admin eyes true).

  • Method Details

    • clearingTintRemovesOnlyThatField

      public static void clearingTintRemovesOnlyThatField(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Removing one color override leaves the other in place. No in-game form, since /sg admin tint clear removes both colors at once; guards that edits to one appearance field never disturb another.

    • glowOverrideCanBeSetAndDropped

      public static void glowOverrideCanBeSetAndDropped(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      A glow override can be set and then dropped back to the definition's glow. In game: run /sg admin glow on and the cow's eyes glow; run /sg admin glow config and they return to the glow its eye definition specifies (none, for the bundled cow).

    • settingOneFieldLeavesOthersAbsent

      public static void settingOneFieldLeavesOthersAbsent(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Setting one color leaves every other field at the definition's value. In game: /sg admin tint iris 1 0 0 turns only the irises red; the corneas keep their default color and the eyes do not start glowing.

    • clearingEveryFieldRemovesTheCompound

      public static void clearingEveryFieldRemovesTheCompound(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Clearing the last override removes the override data entirely. In game: /sg admin tint iris 1 0 0, then /sg admin tint clear; the eyes look as they did before, and on NeoForge or Forge /data get entity <cow> shows no somegoogly:eyeOverrides key in NeoForgeData or ForgeData.

    • clearingTintsPreservesGlow

      public static void clearingTintsPreservesGlow(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Clearing colors keeps a glow override. In game: /sg admin tint iris 1 0 0, /sg admin tint cornea 0 0 1, and /sg admin glow on; then /sg admin tint clear restores the default colors while the eyes keep glowing.

    • snapshotAppliesAllFieldsTogether

      public static void snapshotAppliesAllFieldsTogether(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      A full eye-state snapshot applies eyes, variant, and appearance together, as a client does when it receives one. In game: give the cow a red iris and /sg admin glow on, walk far enough away that it unloads from view, and come back; it reappears with the same eyes, red irises, and glow at once.
